axes.name: Might
axes.fed_by: the gold you sleep on, and food

rank.text: +0.2 magic every sleep and a brighter aura
+4 % Lore from books and brighter eyes
+4 % faith gained and a brighter hoard

talents.name: Thick Hide
talents.text: Wounds hurt a fifth less. Your plates darken.

talents.name: Deep Lungs
talents.text: 25 more stamina for every raid.

talents.name: Great Wings
talents.text: You fly a quarter faster on bigger wings.

talents.name: Mountain Tail
talents.text: Killing an army costs 40 % less stamina and hits half again as hard.

talents.name: Iron Scales
talents.text: Wounds hurt 30 % less. Your scales take a metal sheen.

talents.name: Fury
talents.text: Once wounded, you burn 30 % harder for the rest of the age.

talents.name: Earth-shaker
talents.text: New action Crush: land on a settlement to kill its garrison and frighten every neighbour.

talents.name: Old Bones
talents.text: You heal twice as fast asleep, and slayers succeed a quarter less often.

talents.name: Hotter Breath
talents.text: Each burn does a quarter more for the same stamina. Your fire turns gold.

talents.name: Long Breath
talents.text: Burning costs a quarter less stamina.

talents.name: Sea of Fire
talents.text: A burn spreads 30 % into the owner's lands next to it.

talents.name: Clinging Fire
talents.text: Land you burn recovers at half speed and gives half again as many embers.

talents.name: White Fire
talents.text: Wards no longer halve your fire. It burns white.

talents.name: Molten Gold
talents.text: Taking from a burning land yields half again as much gold.

talents.name: Tower-breaker
talents.text: A burn wrecks the defences of that land until you next sleep.

talents.name: Dread Flame
talents.text: Your deeds frighten half again as much and are remembered 30 % longer.

talents.name: Spell-sense
talents.text: Spells cost a quarter less. Runes show on your scales.

talents.name: Glamour
talents.text: Only half the witnesses see what you do. Your wings cast a shadow.

talents.name: Ward-craft
talents.text: Your wards last twice as long and your lair is warded: slayers succeed 20 % less often.

talents.name: Necromancy
talents.text: Raising the dead costs half.

talents.name: Dragon-sight
talents.text: You see every defence's range and damage, and your forecast is twice as sharp.

talents.name: Hex
talents.text: A curse also halves the court's progress against dragons.

talents.name: Arcane Hide
talents.text: Bolt-throwers and cannons hurt you 40 % less.

talents.name: Sleeper's Ward
talents.text: Every sleep wards the lair: no sieges, and slayers succeed 30 % less often.

talents.name: Old Tongues
talents.text: Demand needs only half the knowledge.

talents.name: Keen Eyes
talents.text: You see when an envoy lies.

talents.name: Star-reading
talents.text: Your forecast is twice as sharp.

talents.name: Premonition
talents.text: You wake when slayers set out for the lair, and meet them awake.

talents.name: Patient Mind
talents.text: Everything but gold digests into a quarter more growth.

talents.name: Teacher
talents.text: Your teaching lasts twice as long.

talents.name: Long Memory
talents.text: Mortals forget you 40 % slower, so fear, faith and oaths hold longer.

talents.name: Riddle-master
talents.text: Hostages and royals give twice the Lore.

talents.name: Tithe
talents.text: Courts pay half again as much tribute.

talents.name: Awe
talents.text: Protecting and giving win half again as much faith.

talents.name: Kobold Servants
talents.text: Thieves fail in your hoard, and the hunt feeds you half again as much.

talents.name: Cult of the Mountain
talents.text: Your most faithful court never falls below half faith.

talents.name: Terror
talents.text: Your deeds frighten 30 % more and are forgotten more slowly.

talents.name: Gilded Throne
talents.text: The gold bed gives a quarter more Might.

talents.name: Dragon-king
talents.text: Courts under oath never break it because they forgot you.

talents.name: Brood of Mortals
talents.text: Courts of dragon-raised lines keep their faith in you, and slayers succeed 20 % less often.
